name: Jay Fai
tagline: Michelin-starred street food, crab omelette legend
taglineZh: 米其林一星街头美食，蟹肉蛋卷传奇
description: Jay Fai, the goggle-wearing street chef, earned Bangkok's most famous Michelin star with her wok-fired crab omelettes and drunken noodles. Expect a queue, cash-only payment and a once-in-a-lifetime taste of old Bangkok.
descriptionZh: 戴着滑雪镜的街头厨师 Jay Fai 凭炭火蟹肉蛋卷与醉面赢得曼谷最著名的米其林一星。需要排队、只收现金，但绝对是一生一次的老曼谷味道。

location.address: 327 Maha Chai Rd, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200

name: Gaggan Anand
tagline: Asia's most daring progressive Indian tasting menu
taglineZh: 亚洲最具实验性的前卫印度料理
description: Chef Gaggan Anand's eponymous restaurant serves one of Asia's most talked-about tasting menus — playful, emoji-decoded progressive Indian cuisine. Consistently ranked among the world's best restaurants; reservations essential.
descriptionZh: 主厨 Gaggan Anand 以自己名字命名的餐厅供应亚洲最受热议的品鉴菜单——用表情符号解码的趣味前卫印度料理。常年跻身全球最佳餐厅榜单，必须提前预约。

location.address: 68/4 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110

name: Thipsamai Pad Thai
description: Thipsamai claims to serve the original Pad Thai, wrapped in a thin egg crepe and cooked over charcoal in the same shophouse since 1966. The 'Sit Jek' original recipe with orange juice remains a rite of passage for Bangkok food pilgrims.
descriptionZh: Thipsamai 自称是最原始的泰式炒粉——薄薄的蛋皮包裹炭火炒制的河粉，自1966年起在同一家老宅营业。招牌「Sit Jek」原版配鲜橙汁，是曼谷美食朝圣必打卡。

location.address: 313 Maha Chai Rd, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200
